newsitem.title: JAPAN: U.S. TREASURIES LITTLE CHANGED AHEAD OF AUCTION.
newsitem.headline: U.S. TREASURIES LITTLE CHANGED AHEAD OF AUCTION.

text.p: U.S. Treasuries were little changed at the Tokyo midday on Thursday as the market waited for a 30-year note auction, the last leg of the Treasury Department's quarterly refunding, later in the day, traders said.
Buying interest in Treasuries will emerge if the yield of the key 6-5/8 percent 30-year bond rises to 6.5 percent, but activity was mostly quiet in morning Tokyo, they added.

"There will be buying interest if the 30-year bond's yield rises to 6.5 percent. Traders are also keen to buy Treasuries if the yield of the 10-year bond climbs to 6.25 percent," a trader at a Japanese bank said.
